domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with denominator alignment, mixed-number normalization, regrouping, and simplification

skills.name: Align fraction forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible fractional forms for subtraction by finding a common denominator, creating equivalent fractions, or expressing a whole number with a fractional part such as 0/n.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator and rewrites one or both fractions as equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/n so its fractional part can be subtracted from another fraction or mixed number.
Tag when the step explicitly checks or states that the fraction parts are already in a compatible denominator and this serves as the alignment step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no alignment or rewriting is actually performed.
Do not tag direct subtraction steps carried out after forms are already compatible.
Do not tag conversion of a mixed number with an improper fractional part into standard mixed-number form; that belongs to S02.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number with a proper fractional part before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number such as 2 3/2, 2 4/3, or 1 5/3 is rewritten as an equivalent mixed number with a proper fraction part.
Tag when the solution explicitly states that a mixed number is being normalized before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions or equivalent-fraction rewrites between fractions.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0/n; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract like-denominator fractions and/or the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are in compatible form and no regrouping is required in that step.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly after alignment or normalization.
Tag when a step performs the actual subtraction even if a later step will simplify or combine the result.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preparatory rewriting steps whose main purpose is denominator alignment or rewriting a whole number; those belong to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used because the fractional difference would otherwise be negative; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag simplification-only or combine-only steps when no subtraction is performed in that step.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: When needed, borrow 1 from the whole part to complete the subtraction and express the result in valid final form, including lowest terms, integer form, or mixed-number form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows or regroups 1 whole into fractional units to make the fractional subtraction possible.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is resolved by borrowing from the whole part.
Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction, reduces a zero-fraction result to an integer, or combines whole and fractional parts into the final reported answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction steps that do not involve regrouping and do not focus on final simplification or final-form expression.
Do not tag denominator alignment or equivalent-fraction conversion; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag the initial subtraction step that produces an unsimplified difference; that belongs to S03.
